First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Second, open-ended experimental plans resist representation as structured labels, which makes objective scoring difficult. To address these challenges, we introduce MineralExp, a benchmark that reformulates geochemical experimental design as a hypothesis-based experiment selection problem, i.e., a multi-label classification problem. We abstract concrete instrument names and procedural details into a shared taxonomy of 19 experimental types across five mineral-system processes: Source, Transport, Deposition, Modification, and Preservation. This taxonomy yields deterministic multi-label targets while accommodating diverse experimental protocols. Constructed from published ore-deposit literature and verified by domain experts, MineralExp comprises 277 cases and 1,572 reference experimental plans. Given a geological hypothesis and initial context, an LLM agent selects the relevant tasks and generates concrete experimental plans, which are scored by multi-label classification metrics and an LLM-as-a-Judge metric. The experimental results show that current agents generally achieve high recall but low precision, tending to propose more experiments than are necessary to test the hypothesis.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MineralExp 基准，将真实矿产勘探中的地球化学实验设计重构为基于假说的多标签实验选择问题，用于评估 LLM 智能体。
summary.methods: 将仪器与流程细节抽象为跨五类成矿过程（Source、Transport、Deposition、Modification、Preservation）的 19 种实验类型分类体系，构建含 277 个案例和 1,572 个参考实验计划的专家校验数据集，并用多标签分类指标与 LLM-as-a-Judge 评分。
summary.relevance: 主题为大语言模型；评估 LLM 智能体在科学实验设计这一上游任务中的能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告当前智能体总体高召回、低精确率，倾向提出多于必要的实验；基准规模与任务范围限于摘要所述矿产勘探设定。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
papers.abstract: Scientific literature search can benefit from locally deployed LLM assistants, which reduce reliance on hosted model providers while giving research teams greater control over their data and infrastructure. This work investigates whether open-weight models can support web-assisted paper retrieval under practical computing constraints. We first characterize inference latency as the input context grows from 512 to 128k tokens on a Mac Studio and a server equipped with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We then evaluate eight models on the retrieval of 70 papers from seven scientific repositories, using queries that represent three levels of domain knowledge. The results show that retrieval success depends strongly on the selected model and the specificity of the query. And that A100 GPUs are generally faster than the Mac Studio, but its unified memory allows larger models that could not be loaded in the tested GPU configuration.

summary.takeaway: 评估开源权重 LLM 在本地部署条件下辅助科学论文检索的可行性，考察检索成功率与推理延迟。
summary.methods: 先在 Mac Studio 与双 NVIDIA A100 服务器上测量输入上下文从 512 到 128k tokens 的推理延迟，再让八个模型在七个科学仓储中对 70 篇论文做三种领域知识水平查询的检索评估。
summary.relevance: 主题为大语言模型；涉及本地 LLM 在科研文献检索中的实际部署评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出检索成功强烈依赖所选模型与查询具体程度；A100 通常更快，但 Mac Studio 统一内存可加载测试 GPU 配置无法容纳的更大模型，结论受具体硬件配置限制。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
papers.abstract: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.

summary.takeaway: 评估了多种无梯度权重编辑方法（含LLM引导）在YOLO26目标检测上的效果，发现测试方法未能一致地迁移到开发子集之外，且LLM引导未显示出可测量的优势。
summary.methods: 在MS COCO数据集上对YOLO26模型进行五阶段实验，比较确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实本地LLM提议、失败感知引导及混合LLM-CMA-ES与随机策略对照；使用Ultralytics mAP50-95在1000张COCO Val2017图像上优化，并在不相交的1500张图像子集上评估。
summary.relevance: 该研究直接探讨大语言模型在优化预训练神经网络权重方面的能力，属于LLM应用于程序/权重编辑的前沿探索，与大语言模型主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示部分结果基于单种子（250次评估），LLM提议中仅53/225满足严格模式，早期张量级执行无法完全验证，且未发现统计显著的LLM优势。

papers.title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: The Thomson problem asks for N unit charges on a sphere with minimum Coulomb energy; for large N the best configurations known are curated in the Cambridge Cluster Database, whose largest-N entries were set in October 2026. We report configurations for N = 912, 1382 and 2502 with energies 0.0036186, 0.0109730 and 0.0614033 below the database values, certified by exact integer arithmetic. All three are numerically strict local minima modulo rotations and keep the defect inventory and scar compositions of the database configurations; the database value for N = 912 had been reached by two different methods. Our search runs unconstrained replica-exchange basin hopping from the database configurations, with a shared pool of minima, recombination of improved regions after relabelling by geometry, and gradient-only polishing; replica-exchange basin hopping alone found the N = 912 and 1382 configurations, the former in one of five runs. We built and ran it with large language model agents (Claude, through a chat interface and the Claude Code agent), and we report every search, including those that failed. Two findings matter for others who search the database. Polishing alone lowers two entries by more than the threshold at which our pipeline reports a candidate, which produced two spurious records until candidates were compared with the polished database energies (the polished baseline). A local-relaxation speed-up passed its exactness test yet found nothing in a controlled comparison in which every arm with full relaxation went below the database value within 15 minutes. We distil three practices for computational discovery with large language model agents: calibrate the search code and verify candidates with code separate from the search, compare candidates with the polished baseline, and test design changes in controlled comparisons with pass criteria fixed in advance.

summary.takeaway: 利用LLM智能体构建的搜索流程找到了Thomson问题中N=912、1382和2502的更低能量构型，并总结了计算发现中使用LLM智能体的三条实践建议。
summary.methods: 从剑桥集群数据库构型出发，运行无约束副本交换盆地跳跃，结合共享极小池、按几何重标记后的改进区域重组及仅梯度抛光；使用Claude（聊天界面和Claude Code智能体）构建并运行流程，报告所有搜索（包括失败）。
summary.relevance: 展示了LLM智能体在科学计算搜索流程构建与执行中的实际作用，属于大语言模型在科研自动化中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供与LLM智能体直接相关的消融实验，LLM的具体贡献程度不明确；部分候选因抛光基线问题曾产生虚假记录。

papers.title: Endogenous expression of mutant RagC in mice results in early-onset dilated cardiomyopathy with features of the Long-Olsen-Distelmaier syndrome
papers.abstract: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a severe heart condition often linked to arrhythmias, clots, and heart failure, for which treatments are not yet curative. Recently, de novo mutations in genes encoding components of the Rag GTPase nutrient signaling pathway, particularly in RRAGC, have been found in unrelated patients with a severe, early-onset DCM syndrome called Long-Olsen-Distelmaier. Cancer cell lines, hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes and zebrafish have been used to study this Ragopathy, but a mammalian model to investigate this syndrome has not been generated. Here, we show that mice engineered to endogenously express mutations in Serine 74 (orthologous to the Serine 75 mutated in patients), exhibit early-onset features of DCM with decreased heart size, fibrosis, diastolic dysfunction and aortic insufficiency, characteristics reminiscent of the human syndrome. Moreover, Rragc-mutant hearts display decreased left ventricular mass and interventricular septum. Endogenous heterozygous expression of Rragc mutant variants result in a milder, sublethal defective physiological cardiac growth with increased systolic and diastolic blood pressure. Mechanistically, active RagC does not cause abnormal increase in cardiomyocyte size, but leads to suppressed transcriptional activity of Tfeb and alterations in cardiomyocyte metabolism. Transcriptional profiling of neonatal mutant hearts reveals multiple signatures of impaired mitochondrial activity. Ex vivo and in vitro analyses of murine cardiomyocyte mitochondria from Rragc-mutant mice show suppressed mitochondrial respiration, disturbed complex IV multimerization and super-complex organization. These data point to abnormal early postnatal heart metabolism by deregulated nutrient - Rag GTPase signaling with a potential molecular explanation to the early onset of DCM in patients with de novo missense mutations in RRAGC, and suggests the relevance of early metabolic interventions in conditions with altered nutrient signaling

summary.takeaway: 构建了内源性表达RagC突变的小鼠模型，再现了Long-Olsen-Distelmaier综合征的早发性扩张型心肌病特征，并提示Rag GTP酶信号失调导致产后心脏代谢异常。
summary.methods: 通过基因工程使小鼠内源性表达RagC Ser74突变（对应人类Ser75），进行心脏表型分析、转录组测序、离体和体外心肌细胞线粒体功能分析。
summary.relevance: 该摘要与检索增强与对齐主题无直接关联，可能因文本中提及“signaling”等词被误匹配。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明样本量、统计方法和具体分子机制的直接因果证据；与检索增强与对齐领域无关。

papers.title: Integrating citizen science and state agency data expands environmental coverage of occurrence data in invasive species distribution models
papers.abstract: Species distribution models (SDMs) are widely used to support risk assessment for invasive non-native plant species (invasive plants), but their performance is constrained by the coverage of occurrence data. Combining occurrences from citizen science (CS) platforms with data from state agency (StAg) monitoring may provide advantages, as these datasets follow different sampling strategies, yet they are rarely integrated. Here, we systematically compare how CS, StAg, and combined data influence the inferred environmental spaces, predictive discrimination, and spatial applicability of SDMs for three widespread invasive plants (A. altissima, H. mantegazzianum, I. glandulifera) in central Germany. We quantified overlap of sampled environmental space between datasets using PCA and Schoener's D and applied a hierarchical SDM utilizing boosted regression trees. We then assessed the Area of Applicability to identify environmental conditions outside of the training data for either model, which could represent priorities for additional monitoring. CS data were biased toward lower-elevation, urbanized environments, whereas StAg data captured higher-elevation, remote habitats, particularly along watercourses. Overlap was lowest for A. altissima, which is spreading, intermediate for H. mantegazzianum, associated with linear habitats, and highest for I. glandulifera, a widespread species, which may reflect differences in invasion stage and habitat associations as well as in sampling. Combined models had slightly higher mean AUC (0.85 +/- 0.07) and TSS (0.58 +/- 0.15), but overall discrimination did not differ significantly among data sources, and the best-performing source differed among species. Applicability (>59%) was high across data sources and species, with combined models showing weaker increases in environmental dissimilarity along environmental gradients. Thus, CS and StAg records sampled distinct parts of the environmental space, a difference reflected in suitability patterns and extrapolation but not detected by AUC and TSS. Integrating both sources broadened the environmental representation of occurrence records without removing their individual biases, which is relevant for invasive plants risk assessments.

summary.takeaway: 整合公民科学和州机构数据可拓宽入侵植物分布模型的环境覆盖范围，但未显著提高模型判别能力，且各数据源的偏差依然存在。
summary.methods: 针对德国中部三种入侵植物，比较公民科学、州机构和合并数据在环境空间重叠（PCA和Schoener's D）、预测判别（AUC、TSS）和适用区域上的差异，使用分层提升回归树模型。
summary.relevance: 该摘要与检索增强与对齐主题无直接关联，可能因涉及数据整合被误匹配。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告模型不确定性或样本量细节；与检索增强与对齐领域无关。

papers.title: A Multi-Layered AI Pipeline for BPMN Generation from Natural Language
papers.abstract: The automated transformation of unstructured natural language process descriptions into Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) diagrams remains a challenging task, due to linguistic ambiguity and the difficulty to detect non-adjacent control-flow relationships. This paper proposes a solution for generating BPMN models from natural language descriptions through a multi-layered pipeline that integrates transformer-based architectures, Large Language Models and ontology population. The proposed method starts with natural language descriptions and separates textual processing, control-flow relation extraction, and structural validation into dedicated components. Entity extraction is performed using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-based transformer model while a control-flow engine captures non-adjacent relationships through LLM-based inference. To improve generalization under limited available data, the approach uses a dynamic few-shot strategy with con- trolled template input construction, enabling improved generalization under limited data availability. Additionally, an ontology population mechanism is introduced to represent the generated process models as semantic knowledge structures. For evaluation purposes we have used from the literature and industry reference processes. Additionally, we have validated the proposed method on a real-world heart disease patients transitional care process, capturing practical constraints and multi-actor collaboration, and serving as an expert-defined benchmark scenario. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance in the relation extraction task, achieving an accuracy of 90.7%, as well as maintaining structural alignment between the generated and reference BPMN models across multiple evaluation scenarios scenarios.

summary.takeaway: 提出一个多层AI流水线，结合Transformer、LLM和本体填充，从自然语言描述生成BPMN模型，在关系提取任务上达到90.7%准确率。
summary.methods: 使用微调的RoBERTa进行实体提取，基于LLM的推理捕获非相邻控制流关系，采用动态少样本策略和受控模板输入构建，并引入本体填充机制；在文献和行业参考流程及真实心脏病患者过渡护理流程上评估。
summary.relevance: 该研究利用大语言模型进行流程建模和知识表示，与大语言模型及图谱构建与表示主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供结构对齐的定量指标、数据集规模和LLM推理的具体错误分析；评估场景有限。

papers.title: Heat Shock Transcription Factor B1 Coordinates Distinct bHLH Modules to Orchestrate Land Plant Adaptation
papers.abstract: Adaptation to terrestrial environments required the evolution of morphological structures, such as rhizoids and air pores, and robust tolerance mechanisms to environmental stress. While these innovations are well-described, the regulatory logic coordinating development with stress signaling during this transition remains largely unknown. Here, we identify Heat Shock Transcription Factor B1 (HSFB1) as a central evolutionary node that bridges this gap in Marchantia polymorpha. Using single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) and gene regulatory network analysis, we reveal that MpHSFB1 is required to activate cell-type-specific programs for terrestrial adaptation, functioning via the regulation of cytokinin and reactive oxygen species (ROS) homeostasis. We find that MpHSFB1 functions through a modular logic: it co-opts a specific set of bHLH transcription factors (including MpbHLH21/40) to drive developmental morphogenesis, while recruiting a distinct partner (MpbHLH51) to confer resistance to prolonged heat stress. This functional uncoupling allows a single ancestral regulator to manage disparate physiological needs. By reconstructing HSFB1 regulons across diverse plant lineages, we propose that MpHSFB1 acted as an ancestral pleiotropic hub that was effectively rewired and subfunctionalized in later angiosperm lineages for land plant evolution.

summary.takeaway: 鉴定出HSFB1作为地钱中协调陆地适应发育与胁迫响应的核心调控节点，通过招募不同bHLH模块分别控制形态发生和热胁迫抗性。
summary.methods: 使用单核RNA测序和基因调控网络分析，在Marchantia polymorpha中研究MpHSFB1功能，并跨植物谱系重建HSFB1 regulon。
summary.relevance: 该研究涉及基因调控网络（regulon）的构建与演化分析，与GRN/Regulon主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供调控网络推断的具体算法和统计验证细节；功能验证主要基于地钱，向被子植物的推广属于推断。

papers.title: Graph learning guided by regulatory and spatial contexts prioritizes natural compound-target pairs in digestive system cancers.
papers.abstract: Heterogeneity in tumor regulatory programs, cellular composition and spatial organization complicates target prioritization for natural compounds. We developed a spatial-context heterogeneous graph neural network ranker (SC-HGNN-Rank) that combines relation-aware graph representations with ranking optimization to integrate compound-target associations, transcriptional regulation, interaction networks, and single-cell and spatial information. The model ranked 600 candidate axes in colon adenocarcinoma (COAD), hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC) and gastric adenocarcinoma (STAD). Under matched training conditions, mean Spearman correlations with the reference ranking were 0.965, 0.967 and 0.976 for leave-one-cancer-out, compound-group holdout and target-group holdout evaluations, respectively. The composite ranking objective improved mean Spearman correlation by 0.049 over a simple objective using the same encoder, whereas removing the spatial module reduced it by 0.147. Model ranking and multilayer evidence prioritized Quercetin-CDK1/MYB-Myeloid in COAD, 4',5-dihydroxyflavone (4',5-DHF)-AR/HDAC1-T/NK in LIHC, and Eriodyctiol-HSP90AB1/HOPX-Fibroblast in STAD. Expanded spatial analyses with expression-matched gene controls assessed associations between target expression and mapped cell abundance. Cellular thermal shift and drug affinity responsive target stability assays showed increased retention of target proteins after compound treatment. In HCT116, JHH-6 and MKN45 cells, the compounds reduced viability, colony formation, migration and invasion cell counts, and increased apoptosis. Target knockdown produced similar growth-inhibitory phenotypes, whereas overexpression attenuated compound-induced effects, supporting the involvement of CDK1, AR and HSP90AB1 in the respective responses. The accompanying Explorer supports candidate searches, evidence inspection and data export. By incorporating regulatory and spatial contexts into natural-compound prioritization, this study provides a reusable approach and experimentally supported candidates for target-directed pharmacological research in digestive system cancers.

summary.takeaway: 开发了空间上下文异质图神经网络排序器SC-HGNN-Rank，整合调控与空间信息优先排序天然化合物-靶点对，并在消化系统癌症中实验验证了多个候选轴。
summary.methods: 构建关系感知图表示与排序优化相结合的模型，整合化合物-靶点关联、转录调控、相互作用网络及单细胞和空间信息；在COAD、LIHC和STAD中排序600个候选轴，并进行细胞热位移和药物亲和响应靶稳定性等实验验证。
summary.relevance: 该方法利用图学习整合调控网络和空间上下文进行靶点优先级排序，与GRN/Regulon主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模型在独立外部数据集上的泛化性能；实验验证集中于少数候选，排序的临床转化价值需进一步评估。

papers.title: S-palmitoylation at the interface between lipophagy and macrophage immunometabolism in sepsis: mechanistic evidence and translational questions.
papers.abstract: Sepsis seldom presents as a uniform immune phenotype. Inflammation and immune suppression often overlap, but their balance shifts across patients, organs, and illness stages. Macrophages sit within this variation, coordinating cytokine output, microbial clearance, antigen processing, and presentation. Lipophagy removes lipid droplets through selective autophagy. The released fatty acids can feed mitochondrial β-oxidation, helping macrophages balance lipid storage with energy demand. Reduced flux may instead leave excess droplets, compromise mitochondrial function, and blunt antimicrobial activity. Whether this sequence directly drives sepsis-associated immunoparalysis remains uncertain. Protein S-palmitoylation offers a second potential control point through reversible cysteine S-acylation. Studies have linked this modification to ATG16L1 and ATG4B, and to immune regulators including MYD88, NLRP3, and CD80. Most of that evidence, however, comes from models other than sepsis, so its relevance cannot be assumed. This review therefore examines the proposed links among macrophage lipophagy, immunometabolic failure, and sepsis-associated immunoparalysis while keeping experimentally established observations separate from mechanistic inference. Taken together, current findings support S-palmitoylation as a plausible regulatory layer, but they do not establish an integrated causal axis linking S-palmitoylation, lipophagy, and immunometabolism in sepsis. This framework awaits direct testing in primary macrophages, organ-specific sepsis models, and longitudinal clinical cohorts.

summary.takeaway: 综述探讨了S-棕榈酰化、脂噬和巨噬细胞免疫代谢在脓毒症中的潜在联系，但指出现有证据尚不能确立整合的因果轴。
summary.methods: 文献综述，区分实验确立的观察与机制推断，梳理S-棕榈酰化与ATG16L1、ATG4B及MYD88、NLRP3、CD80等免疫调控因子的关联。
summary.relevance: 该综述涉及机制推理和证据整合，与机制推理及检索增强与对齐主题有部分关联（但主要是生物学机制）。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据；多数证据来自非脓毒症模型，直接相关性不确定。

papers.title: Cell type-specific coexpression networks funnel genetic risk into core genes
papers.abstract: Genetic effects on common disease are mediated through many genes in multiple cell types, yet how networks connect genome-wide genetic risk to core disease genes remains unclear. One key limitation is that disease-related gene networks are likely cell type-specific, but these are poorly captured by bulk and pseudobulk coexpression networks. Here we used population-scale single-cell immune transcriptomes to decompose interindividual gene coexpression into cell type-shared and -specific networks, which have nearly opposite properties. Shared network hubs were enriched in constrained housekeeping genes, whereas cell type-specific hubs were dynamically expressed, rapidly evolving, and enriched in cell type-matched enhancers and transcription factors. Specific hubs enriched for immune disease GWAS heritability, Mendelian genes, and drug targets; these enrichments were absent or weak for non-immune disease and shared hubs. Gene-gene network edges enriched for causal trans regulation identified by trans eQTLs and perturb-seq, with shared hubs skewed to upstream regulators and specific hubs skewed to downstream disease-proximal genes. Specific hubs increased the relative success of genetically supported immune drug targets from 1.7-fold to 2.7-fold; for example, the lupus drug target BAFF is a monocyte hub connected to the Mendelian gene TREX1 and interferon-responsive genes. Overall, accounting for shared housekeeping networks reveals that cell type-specific networks funnel genetic risk into downstream and dynamic core disease genes.

summary.takeaway: 该研究利用群体规模单细胞免疫转录组，将个体间基因共表达分解为细胞类型共享网络和细胞类型特异性网络，发现二者性质近乎相反；细胞类型特异性枢纽富集免疫疾病GWAS遗传力、孟德尔基因和药物靶点，从而把遗传风险汇聚到下游核心疾病基因。
summary.methods: 基于群体规模单细胞免疫转录组数据，把个体间基因共表达拆分为细胞类型共享与细胞类型特异性网络；比较两类枢纽的基因约束、表达动态、进化特征及增强子/转录因子富集；结合GWAS遗传力、孟德尔基因、药物靶点、trans eQTL和perturb-seq对网络边进行富集分析。
summary.relevance: 该研究与“单细胞扰动”主题直接相关：摘要明确使用perturb-seq识别因果trans调控，并检验网络边与这些扰动实验证据的对应关系，说明细胞类型特异性网络可用于连接遗传风险与下游疾病基因。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明单细胞免疫转录组的具体样本量、细胞类型覆盖范围及perturb-seq数据来源，也未给出共享与特异性网络划分的具体统计阈值；因此结果的外推性和方法细节需查阅全文确认。
